Kingston Flemings - Day-To-Day: Flemings (back tightness) will not return to Friday's game against the Bulls.
Mouhamed Gueye - Out: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Keshon Gilbert - Out: Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Bulls.
Asa Newell - Out: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Chicago.
Henri Veesaar - Out: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

Jalen Smith - Day-To-Day: Smith (hand) exited Friday's 125-117 win over the Hawks in overtime and did not return, finishing with 15 points (6-15 FG, 1-6 3Pt, 2-2 FT), 12 rebounds, three assists and three steals across 32 minutes.
Dailyn Swain - Out: Swain (back) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.
Tobe Awaka - Out: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Hawks.
Caleb Wilson - Out: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Evan Mobley - Out: Mobley (toe) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.
Sam Merrill - Out: Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.
Nae'Qwan Tomlin - Out: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.
Stephen Curry - Out: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Brandon Williams - Out: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.
Kristaps Porzingis - Out: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
Moses Moody - Out: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Jimmy Butler III - Out: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Marcus Smart - Suspension: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Clint Capela - Out: Head coach Ime Udoka stated Monday that Capela (ankle) could be cleared to return either Nov. 15 in Washington or Nov. 16 in Miami, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
Steven Adams - Out: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could return as soon as Sunday's game at Washington, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

Aaron Nesmith - Day-To-Day: Nesmith exited to the locker room in the final seconds of Friday's 106-104 win over the Knicks due to an apparent hand/wrist injury, Tony East of Forbes.com reports. He posted 18 points (7-10 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 2-2 FT), seven rebounds and one assist in 33 minutes.
Tyrese Haliburton - Out: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.
Johnny Furphy - Out: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.
Ben Sheppard - Out: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
Brandon Ingram - Out: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Yanic Konan Niederhauser - Out: Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
Bradley Beal - Out: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Jordan Miller - Out: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Quinten Post - Out: Post (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against New Orleans.
Zach Edey - Out: Edey won't play in Friday's game against the Pelicans due to left ankle injury management.
Scotty Pippen Jr. - Out: Pippen (back) remains out for Wednesday's game against Denver, Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site reports.
Richie Saunders - Out: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Klay Thompson - Out: Thompson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Cavaliers.
Pelle Larsson - Out: Larsson (illness) is out for Friday's game against Cleveland.
Dejounte Murray - Out: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.
Bryce McGowens - Out: McGowens (elbow) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.
Yves Missi - Out: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.
Trey Murphy III - Out: Murphy (knee) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.
Trendon Watford - Out: Watford (ankle) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.
Ajay Mitchell - Out: Mitchell (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.
Thomas Sorber - Out: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.
Jaylin Williams - Out: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland and remains out indefinitely.

Cason Wallace - Out: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
Chet Holmgren - Out: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

Jalen Williams - Out: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.
Jonathan Isaac - Out: Isaac (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Sacramento.
Paolo Banchero - Out: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Noah Penda - Out: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Izaiyah Nelson - Out: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.
Chris Youngblood - Out: Youngblood (foot) is out for Friday's game against Sacramento.
Vit Krejci - Out: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Shaedon Sharpe - Out: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Precious Achiuwa - Out: Achiuwa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Trail Blazers.
Maxime Raynaud - Out: Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.
Ben Simmons - Out: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
Tobias Harris - Out: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Chicago, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
Jayden Quaintance - Out: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

Trey Alexander - Out: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.
Lauri Markkanen - Out: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Jusuf Nurkic - Out: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.
